title: Convexity of the squared Gaussian quantile
statement: Let $Q(\alpha)=\inf\{t\in\mathbb R:\alpha\le\Phi(t)\}$, where $\Phi$ is the standard Gaussian distribution function. The function $p\mapsto Q(p)^2$ is convex on $(0,1)$.
replaced: Let $\Phi$ and $\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and put $Q=\Phi^{-1}$ and $I(p)=\varphi(Q(p))$ for $0<p<1$. The function $p\mapsto Q(p)^2$ is convex on $(0,1)$.
